text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her long-awaited race debut just around the corner, King Halo declares with a powerful and confident laugh that she'll be the first to debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Amid this, we catch Grass Wonder's recent debut being praised on a TV program playing in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As it turns out, King Halo wasn't the first to debut after all. But it doesn't matter, because our goal is to claim first place. It's time to get out there and win!
